\begin{lexlean}{Engine}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.bool@1.2.0}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.nat@1.2.0}
\useglossary{prism.arch@1.0.0}
\importmodule{Compliance}
\importmodule{Core}
\importmodule{Interaction}
\title{Project checking engine}
\begin{semanticmodule}
inductive{
  name: StepError,
  type_parameters: [],
  parameters: [],
  constructors: [
    {name: Parse, fields: [Interaction::ParseError]},
    {name: Refused, fields: [Core::Violation]},
    {name: LineOverflow, fields: []}
  ]
}

structure{
  name: LineFailure,
  type_parameters: [],
  parameters: [],
  fields: [{name: line, type: UInt32}, {name: error, type: StepError}]
}

inductive{
  name: Outcome,
  type_parameters: [],
  parameters: [],
  constructors: [
    {name: Accepted, fields: [Core::Project]},
    {name: Rejected, fields: [Core::Project, (List Compliance::Finding)]},
    {name: Failed, fields: [LineFailure]}
  ]
}

definition{
  name: runLines,
  parameters: [lines : (List String), project : Core::Project, line : UInt32],
  result: (Result Core::Project LineFailure),
  body: (match lines
    | List.nil => (ctor Result.ok [Core::Project, LineFailure] var{name: project})
    | List.cons text rest => (match (prim checked_add line (1 : UInt32) : (Option UInt32))
      | Option.none => (ctor Result.error [Core::Project, LineFailure] (record LineFailure {line := line, error := (ctor StepError.LineOverflow)}))
      | Option.some next => (if (prim equal text "" : Bool) then (runLines rest var{
        name: project
      } next) else (match (Interaction::parseLine text)
        | Result.error problem => (ctor Result.error [Core::Project, LineFailure] (record LineFailure {line := next, error := (ctor StepError.Parse problem)}))
        | Result.ok intent => (match (Interaction::applyIntent var{name: project} intent)
          | Result.error violation => (ctor Result.error [Core::Project, LineFailure] (record LineFailure {line := next, error := (ctor StepError.Refused violation)}))
          | Result.ok updated => (runLines rest updated next)))))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: lines
}

definition{
  name: certifyWith,
  parameters: [project : Core::Project, found : (List Compliance::Finding)],
  result: Outcome,
  body: (match found
    | List.nil => (ctor Outcome.Accepted var{name: project})
    | List.cons head rest => (ctor Outcome.Rejected var{name: project} (cons head rest)))
}

definition{
  name: certify,
  parameters: [project : Core::Project],
  result: Outcome,
  body: (certifyWith var{name: project} (project (Compliance::findings var{name: project}) items)),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: conclude,
  parameters: [run : (Result Core::Project LineFailure)],
  result: Outcome,
  body: match{
    branches: [
      {body: (ctor Outcome.Failed failure), binders: [failure], constructor: Result.error},
      {body: (certify var{name: project}), binders: [project], constructor: Result.ok}
    ],
    scrutinee: run
  },
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: isAccepted,
  parameters: [outcome : Outcome],
  result: Bool,
  body: match{
    branches: [
      {body: true, binders: [project], constructor: Outcome.Accepted},
      {body: false, binders: [project, found], constructor: Outcome.Rejected},
      {body: false, binders: [failure], constructor: Outcome.Failed}
    ],
    scrutinee: outcome
  }
}

theorem{
  name: certifyWithAcceptsExactly,
  parameters: [project : Core::Project, found : (List Compliance::Finding)],
  statement: ((isAccepted (certifyWith var{name: project} found)) = (Compliance::noFindings found)),
  proof: cases{
    branches: [
      {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: nil},
      {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [head, rest], constructor: cons}
    ],
    scrutinee: found
  }
}

theorem{
  name: certifyRequiresCompliance,
  parameters: [project : Core::Project],
  statement: ((isAccepted (certify var{
    name: project
  })) = (Compliance::compliant var{name: project})),
  proof: apply{
    arguments: [var{name: project}, (project (Compliance::findings var{name: project}) items)],
    theorem: certifyWithAcceptsExactly
  },
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: failedRunNeverAccepted,
  parameters: [failure : LineFailure],
  statement: ((isAccepted (conclude (ctor Result.error [Core::Project, LineFailure] failure))) = false),
  proof: reflexivity{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: completedRunAcceptedOnlyIfCompliant,
  parameters: [project : Core::Project],
  statement: ((isAccepted (conclude (ctor Result.ok [Core::Project, LineFailure] var{
    name: project
  }))) = (Compliance::compliant var{name: project})),
  proof: apply{arguments: [var{name: project}], theorem: certifyRequiresCompliance},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: violationCode,
  parameters: [violation : Core::Violation],
  result: String,
  body: (match violation
    | Core::Violation.DuplicateNode => "duplicate-node"
    | Core::Violation.UnknownNode => "unknown-node"
    | Core::Violation.SelfEdge => "self-edge"
    | Core::Violation.DuplicateEdge => "duplicate-edge"
    | Core::Violation.OutputSource => "output-source"
    | Core::Violation.InputTarget => "input-target"
    | Core::Violation.NotAnInput => "not-an-input"
    | Core::Violation.DuplicatePii => "duplicate-pii"
    | Core::Violation.DuplicatePolicy => "duplicate-policy")
}

definition{
  name: parseErrorCode,
  parameters: [problem : Interaction::ParseError],
  result: String,
  body: (match problem
    | Interaction::ParseError.UnknownCommand => "unknown-command"
    | Interaction::ParseError.WrongArity => "wrong-arity"
    | Interaction::ParseError.EmptyField => "empty-field"
    | Interaction::ParseError.UnknownKind => "unknown-kind"
    | Interaction::ParseError.InvalidNumber => "invalid-number")
}

definition{
  name: stepErrorCode,
  parameters: [error : StepError],
  result: String,
  body: (match error
    | StepError.Parse problem => (parseErrorCode problem)
    | StepError.Refused violation => (violationCode violation)
    | StepError.LineOverflow => "line-overflow")
}

definition{
  name: outcomeText,
  parameters: [outcome : Outcome],
  result: String,
  body: match{
    branches: [
      {
        body: (prim join (cons "status accepted" (cons (Core::canonicalText var{name: project}) (nil String))) "" : String),
        binders: [project],
        constructor: Outcome.Accepted
      },
      {
        body: (prim join (cons "status rejected" (cons (Compliance::findingsText (project (Compliance::sortFindings found) items)) (cons (Core::canonicalText var{name: project}) (nil String)))) "" : String),
        binders: [project, found],
        constructor: Outcome.Rejected
      },
      {
        body: (prim join (cons "status error\n" (cons (prim join (cons "line" (cons (prim format_decimal (project failure line) : String) (cons (stepErrorCode (project failure error)) (nil String)))) " " : String) (nil String))) "" : String),
        binders: [failure],
        constructor: Outcome.Failed
      }
    ],
    scrutinee: outcome
  },
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext]
}
\end{semanticmodule}
\end{lexlean}
